text:
Maya R: Customer onacct-872 is seeing embedding returns with dim=768 but their client expects 1536. They just started hitting our /v1/embeddings endpoint after a config change. Error shows downstream mismatch and immediate model fallback in logs. Can we triage?

Maya R: quick snippet from their stacktrace: 
```
TypeError: expected embedding length 1536 got 768
at handler (app/embed_consume.go:144)
```

Jon P: ack — did they share the raw request? headers?

Maya R: yes, pasted below (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer sk-org_XXXXX
X-Project-Id: pj-9999
Content-Type: application/json
{
 "model": "redwood-embed-text-v2-highdim",
 "input": ["test"]
}
```

Jon P: interesting. They are sending both an org-scoped key (sk-org_...) and the X-Project-Id header. Our routing logic should prefer the project key mapping when present. If we fall back to org mapping that might map to v1-compact which returns 768 dims.

Priya S: tagging eng-runtime — @Alex T — can you check routing precedence for auth header vs project header? Also any recent change to model alias table?

Alex T: looking now. I pulled router logs for that request id (req=ac3f1d). I see a fallback to org-default-model: "redwood-embed-text-v1-compact" around the same time as a cache miss in model-mapping-service. Full excerpt: 
```
[router] req=ac3f1d auth=org:acct-872 project=pj-9999 mapping=MISS => selected=org-default(redwood-embed-text-v1-compact)
```

Alex T: root cause appears to be a race where the mapping cache miss caused us to evaluate org key mapping before the project mapping could be resolved. Normally we try project mapping first when X-Project-Id present, but the cache state and short-circuit for org keys produced the wrong selection.

Jon P: that explains the dim mismatch. Was there a concurrent deploy that touched mapping-service?

Alex T: we deployed a small TTL bump to the mapping cache yesterday morning (176xxx) but no structural changes. The bump made some codepaths do an immediate org-lookup on auth header before waiting for project-resolution promise. I'll open a PR to fix order and add a safety check: if model dims != requested dims then don't short-circuit — fallback to runtime-compatible variant.

Maya R: customer impacted: 2 hours of failed ingest, they sent a screenshot with tokenization logs. They want a timeline and mitigation.

BillingOps: FYI — if embeddings were produced under a different model than billed, we need to reconcile. Provide list of request ids and models used. Could be revenue/usage mismatch.

Alex T: action items from eng-runtime:
- roll back TTL bump in mapping cache (hotfix)
- add guard to prefer project mapping when X-Project-Id header exists
- add a runtime dimension-check assert that logs an alert and retries selection if dim mismatch
- add unit + integration test for mixed auth headers

Jon P: can you reproduce locally with both keys? I'll ask customer for a single minimal curl that reproduces.

Maya R: customer provided this repro curl (works for us locally):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-org_XXXXX" \
 -H "X-Project-Id: pj-9999" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-text-v2-highdim","input":["a quick test"]}'
```

Priya S: thanks — I also want to add a non-invasive mitigation: in support we can advise customers to avoid sending both the org key and project header simultaneously for now. Provide explicit example to set only the project-scoped key.

Alex T: deploying hotfix to canary now (canary pool: 10% traffic to mapping-service). I put the revert TTL PR and the selection-guard PR in review.

deploy-bot: deploy started by Alex T -> mapping-service v2.14.3-canary (canary: 10%): https://ci.internal/9872

Alex T: canary looks good — no dim-mismatch alerts after ~20m under test workload. Rolling to 100% in 10m.

Jon P: once fully rolled, Maya — can you ask customer to re-run their job? Also collect a couple request ids so we can correct billing if necessary.

Maya R: will do. I gave them the ask and offered a small usage credit. They re-ran and reported embeddings now return 1536 dims. Confirmed with request ids: ac3f1d (bad), ac3f2e (good).

BillingOps: received request ids. We'll reconcile and patch billing records for ac3f1d to reflect the smaller model usage if needed.

Priya S: follow-ups:
- create support KB about "Both org key + project header — avoid" and link to model selection behavior
- schedule a postmortem with eng-runtime to discuss guardrails and better testing for mixed auth cases
- add e2e test to CI that verifies embedding dims match model metadata when multiple auth headers present

Alex T: opened runtime ticket RUNTIME-1427 for the fix and tests. Also added a small analytics alert for any future occurrences of embedding-dim mismatches.

Maya R: customer happy with fix and credit. Keeping thread open until billing reconciliation is complete. Thanks all. :tada:
